claims.text: 美联储将联邦基金利率目标区间上调至 1/4 至 1/2 个百分点（0.25%–0.50%）。

citations.quotation: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.

claims.text: 唯一投反对票的是 James Bullard，他主张本次加息 0.5 个百分点，将目标区间上调至 1/2 至 3/4 个百分点。

citations.quotation: Voting against this action was James Bullard, who preferred at this meeting to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 0.5 percentage point to 1/2 to 3/4 percent.

claims.text: Patrick Harker 在本次会议上作为替代成员投票。

citations.quotation: Patrick Harker voted as an alternate member at this meeting.

counterarguments.text: 虽然 Bullard 反对并主张更大幅加息，但委员会多数仍决定较小幅度（25 个基点），并预期将持续加息；委员会的立场在声明中体现为对持续加息的预期而非立即大幅加息。

citations.quotation: anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate
